meta.rawHtml:
Card Title 1

This is a beautiful responsive card with smooth hover animations. Perfect for portfolios or UI sections.

Card Title 2

This card scales on hover, the image zooms, and the button animates. Looks amazing on mobile too.

Card Title 3

Fully responsive, modern, and animated card. You can copy this structure for multiple cards.
